releaseNotes: AI Study personal-key flow hardening: your Gemini key is now verified before it is ever saved, and a failed secure-store save no longer causes a confusing invalid-key loop (the key still works, and the app says so honestly). The 'Add my Gemini API key' button hides itself once a key is connected and never appears for content-refused answers where a key cannot help. Under the hood: upgraded secure-key storage and clearer AI diagnostics.
